summary: The draft is well cited on design-based and GATE-design literature, but its central thesis (exposure-mapping misspecification drives error), its opening interference/DiM-bias claims, and its interval-undercoverage discussion rest on little or no direct citation support.
missing_literatures: foundational interference/spillover and bias of naive estimators
variance and confidence-interval estimation under network dependence

rewrite_targets.reason: The thesis that accuracy is governed by fidelity of the fitted exposure mapping, and the corner-extrapolation account in Results, are the paper's core claims. The term 'exposure mapping' is used throughout but only Aronow2013EstimatingAC is cited, and no work on misspecified exposure mappings, unknown interference, or extrapolation to all-treated/all-control corners (overlap/positivity) is cited, so the positioning relative to prior analyses of this failure mode is missing.
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: accuracy is governed by the fidelity of the fitted exposure mapping to the generating mechanism
search_topics: misspecified exposure mapping bias average treatment effect network interference
average treatment effects under unknown interference
positivity overlap violation extrapolation global treatment effect network

rewrite_targets.reason: The opening paragraph asserts that A/B tests on networks violate no-interference and that difference-in-means is systematically biased for the GATE under interference, with no foundational citation for either statement; the only citations there are for HT estimators.
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: The difference-in-means (DiM) estimator, which is unbiased without interference, is systematically biased for the GATE under interference
search_topics: causal inference with interference and spillover effects in randomized experiments
bias of difference-in-means under network interference A/B tests

rewrite_targets.reason: The draft reports 0.839 coverage against a nominal 0.95 and notes that HC1 sandwich intervals ignore cluster dependence and use no resampling, but cites no work on variance estimation or confidence intervals under network dependence, so the negative result is not connected to known inference approaches (beyond Han2023ModelbasedRA in related work).
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: ignores cluster dependence under the cluster design and uses no resampling
